name: The Shift — Queue Mode Reel
tagline: Four structural game modes inside a single adaptive study session.
audience: PTCB students · pharmacy educators · social media · product demos
estimatedSecNote: Actual duration is driven by ElevenLabs per-line synthesis in DemoForge

steps.narration: The Shift doesn't just quiz you. It mixes eight game modes into one adaptive session — and four of them are full-on mini-games.
The queue reads your mastery level and picks the right mode at the right moment. Let's enter each one and play a round.
Blueprints — a real pharmacy workflow, scrambled into steps. Rebuild it in the correct order. One wrong pick drains stability — lose it all and the procedure collapses.
The Drop — a drug name falls from the top. Match it to the right category lane before it crosses the capture threshold. Hesitate and your stress meter climbs.
The Minefield — a five-by-five grid of clinical hazards. Every cell hides a question. Pick wrong and the mine detonates — navigate clean or the breach fails.
Field Work — real pharmacy scenarios as classified dossiers. Read the incident report, choose your call, and commit. This is where the textbook meets the dispensing counter.
The Queue sequences all of it — automatically. One session. Eight modes. Zero manual setup. The Shift adapts to you.
